_about: Public-domain Samuel Hopkins (1721-1803, New Divinity theologian, pupil and biographer of Jonathan Edwards, pastor at Newport, Rhode Island, an early opponent of the slave trade) for the Word Hoard: the Works (Boston: Doctrinal Tract and Book Society, 1854, 3 vols, with a memoir of his life), including the System of Doctrines, raw Internet Archive OCR from Princeton scans. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 7 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
